verdict.rationale: Qdrant ships its own disposable, isolated instances that can serve as test environments separate from production. These include a one-line local Docker image, an in-memory mode that users describe as similar to sqlite for POCs, and a free-forever 1GB cloud cluster for trying out. However, there is no documented dedicated sandbox or staging feature, and no explicit separation from production data. Missing for 10: a first-party sandbox/staging environment feature, documented workflows for cloning or masking production data into a test instance, and first-party docs (rather than community reports) on in-memory mode and free-tier testing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: it allows an 'in-memory' version similar to sqlite
